cases.state: seeded fixture; the OpenAI stand-in reset, no ad connection, the Advertiser API key in /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt
setup: for id in $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[].connection_id'); do p202 ad-connection delete "$id" --force --json >/dev/null; done; printf %s 'sk-ads-eval-key-0001' > /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt; true
cases.ask: Connect my ChatGPT Ads account. The Advertiser API key is in /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt. Then set up its pixel, a Conversions API key and the event settings.

checks.run: p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '[.data[] | "account=\(.account.id) name=\(.account.name) status=\(.status) ads_key=\(.credentials_set.advertiser_api_key) capi_key=\(.credentials_set.conversions_api_key) pixel=\(.setup.pixel.pixel_id != null) events=\(.setup.event_settings | length)"] | join(";")'
includes: account=adacct_123 name=Northwind Outfitters status=connected ads_key=true capi_key=true pixel=true events=1

cases.state: seeded fixture; one ad connection to the stand-in's account, whose Spring sale (cmpn_101) is active
setup: for id in $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[].connection_id'); do p202 ad-connection delete "$id" --force --json >/dev/null; done; printf %s 'sk-ads-eval-key-0001' > /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt; p202 ad-connection create --api-key-file /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt --json >/dev/null
cases.ask: My ChatGPT Ads campaign Spring sale is losing money. Pause it.

checks.run: p202 ad-campaign get $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[0].connection_id') cmpn_101 --json | jq -r '"status=\(.data.status)"'
p202 ad-campaign get $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[0].connection_id') cmpn_102 --json | jq -r '"status=\(.data.status)"'

cases.state: seeded fixture; one ad connection; the stand-in's Trial sign-ups (cmpn_102) has no tracking template
setup: for id in $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[].connection_id'); do p202 ad-connection delete "$id" --force --json >/dev/null; done; printf %s 'sk-ads-eval-key-0001' > /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt; p202 ad-connection create --api-key-file /tmp/p202-eval-ads-key.txt --json >/dev/null
cases.ask: Put the Get Links tracking template on my ChatGPT Ads campaign Trial sign-ups.

checks.run: p202 ad-campaign get $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[0].connection_id') cmpn_102 --json | jq -r '.data.query_string_template'
p202 ad-campaign get $(p202 ad-connection list --json | jq -r '.data[0].connection_id') cmpn_101 --json | jq -r '"template=\(.data.query_string_template)"'
